maddeler.e:
نتفاخر (form VI)
# نَتَفَاخَرُ (natafāḵaru) /na.ta.faː.xa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
# نَتَفَاخَرَ (natafāḵara) /na.ta.faː.xa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
# نَتَفَاخَرْ (natafāḵar) /na.ta.faː.xar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
